plan: Hold all patient-facing state in a single public `session` dict with exactly the four contract keys, reassigned wholesale on begin/abandon so partial writes can never leak.

Route every action through `handle`, which dispatches on `type` and validates preconditions and payload shape before any mutation, so invalid or malformed actions return an `Error:` screen with accepted data untouched.
Centralize screen construction in one builder that emits exactly `prompt`/`messages`/`choices` and includes appointment choices (in input order) precisely when the prompt is `Choose appointment`.
Derive post-correction prompts from a `next unmet` helper (contact -> appointment -> review) and reuse it for error-screen prompts so screens stay deterministic functions of state.

Implement `run_once` against duck-typed `action_source.read_action()` and `screen_sink.display(screen)`, raising `RuntimeError` before touching either when one is missing, so unittest fakes plug in with no framework support.
mechanisms: single authoritative session dictionary with atomic reset on begin/abandon
type-dispatched action interpreter with validate-before-mutate guards
deterministic screen builder keyed on prompt for choice inclusion
injectable duck-typed action source and screen sink with precondition RuntimeError in run_once
